text: Understanding Git branching is an important skill for developers. In a version control workflow, branches let you work on new features without affecting the main code. A feature branch is created for each new task, keeping changes separate and safe. When the work is finished, you can merge the branch back into the main one. Teams often use pull requests to review code before merging, which helps catch mistakes early. This simple workflow keeps projects organised and reduces conflicts. By learning branches, merges, and pull requests, you can collaborate more effectively and manage your code with confidence.
